properties.about: The groom's own settings, in the order of Maya's Attribute Editor for the groom (AEgroomLabShapeTemplate.mel): the app's Properties dock and Blender's groom panel lay them out the same way. Each item names the Maya attribute (maya), the app's control (app) and the Blender property (blender); custom blocks (custom: the MEL proc) list the rows they show (parts).

items.label: Windows
items.tip: The two windows everything is done in

parts.label: Groom Tools
parts.tip: Brushes, guide groups, painted maps, sculpt layers

parts.label: Graph Editor
parts.tip: The look: the groom's node graph

items.label: Preview Density
items.tip: The share of the strands the viewport evaluates and draws: the same strands, fewer (renders and exports get every strand)

items.label: Point Budget (M)
items.tip: Preview point budget, in millions of strand points: the most the viewport holds (each groom keeps a copy, the draw buffers more); past it the preview thins itself. 0: no limit

tips.app: Points the preview may hold, in thousands: past it each Scatter thins to fit (0: no limit)
tips.blender: At most this many thousand points in the viewport: a denser preview shows fewer of the same strands (0: no limit). Final renders get every strand

items.label: Out Strand Count
items.tip: The strands the viewport shows now (at the preview's density)

items.label: Locked
items.tip: A locked groom ignores brushes and part strokes

items.label: Inputs
items.tip: What the groom is made from: always visible, and changeable here

parts.label: Scalp
parts.tip: The mesh the hair grows on

tips.app: The mesh the hair grows on: Transfer moves the groom onto another mesh

parts.label: Rest
parts.tip: The scalp's undeformed shape (set automatically for a skinned or blend-shaped scalp)

parts.label: Scalps
parts.tip: Other meshes the hair grows on, joined after the scalp: a Scalp node naming one grows on it alone

parts.label: Guides
parts.tip: The guides the groom interpolates

parts.label: Collider
parts.tip: Add a mesh the strands keep off: a body, a collar, another character

tips.app: Meshes the strands keep off, by name (a ColliderMesh node naming one reads it): the groom file's colliders and the props

parts.label: File
parts.tip: The groom file this groom is linked to: GroomLab > Groom Files

tips.app: The groom's file: Reload reads it again (another host's edits), Save writes it

items.label: Scalp Subdivision
items.tip: Catmull-Clark smoothing of the scalp, so the hair sits on the smoothed surface (the viewport draws it, the brushes and picks hit it; painted maps stay on the scalp's own vertices). Each level makes 4x the triangles. The Scalp node's default (Match Render) follows it; saved with the groom

items.label: Follow Scalp
items.tip: Evaluate on the rest mesh and carry each strand rigidly with its root: fast per frame, the rest shape kept. Needs a rest mesh. See the docs (Rigs and follow-the-scalp).

items.label: Scale Source
items.tip: What the groom's sizes grow with. Surface Area: the scalp's surface at the start frame (survives Freeze Transformations). Transform Only: its transform and rig scale (survives remodelling). Off: fixed scene units.

items.label: Groom Scale
items.tip: What the groom is scaled by with its scalp: 1.00x at the size it was groomed at. Set Scale Reference makes the scalp's size now 1x (the groom then keeps the sizes its params say at this size)

items.label: Controls
items.tip: Sliders that Control nodes add: in the Graph Editor, right-click a param > Drive with Slider

items.label: Hair Color
items.tip: The hair's color: the HairColor node making the output, its everyday params here (the Graph Editor has the rest)

parts.label: Mode
parts.tip: Natural (the melanin mode): pigment and redness, and a dye, as real hair. Picked color (the color mode): the color you pick, as it shows and renders (white hair: white)

parts.label: Color
parts.tip: The hair's color as it shows and renders (mode Color)

parts.label: Melanin
parts.tip: Pigment: 0 white or blond, 1 black

parts.label: Redness
parts.tip: Share of red pigment: 0 brown or black, 1 red

parts.label: Dye
parts.tip: A color dyeing the pigment (white: none)

parts.label: Result
parts.tip: The color the pigment and dye make, before the randomness (what renders, a hair color as aiStandardHair's base color)

parts.label: Greys
parts.tip: Share of grey and white strands

parts.label: Melanin Random
parts.tip: Each strand's melanin up to this much more or less

parts.label: Value Random
parts.tip: Each strand up to this share lighter or darker

parts.label: Hue Random
parts.tip: Each strand's hue turned, up to half a turn either way at 1

parts.label: Saturation Random
parts.tip: Each strand's saturation up to this share more or less

parts.label: Clump Share
parts.tip: How much of the randomness the strands of one clump share: 0 each its own, 1 the whole clump alike (needs a Clump before HairColor)

parts.label: Tip Color
parts.tip: The color the strands blend to toward the tip (with Tip Strength above 0)

parts.label: Tip Strength
parts.tip: How far toward Tip Color the tips go, 0-1 (along the node's tipProfile)

parts.label: Tip Offset Random
parts.tip: Each strand's tip color starts at its own place

parts.label: Specular
parts.tip: Highlight strength (0.3: aiStandardHair's full specular tint)

parts.label: Roughness
parts.tip: Highlight spread, 0 sharp to 1 broad

items.label: Display Hair
items.tip: The hair in the viewport: the strands, instances, scales, cards and strand meshes (the Groom Tools' eye; the guides stay, renders keep it)

items.label: Display Guides
items.tip: The guides in the viewport

items.label: Display Flow
items.tip: The flow arrows and the field they make (a pale preview)

items.label: Display Tubes
items.tip: Each guide's tube, the volume its children and Interpolate's Fill Tubes fill: its shape and sections along it

items.label: Display Instances
items.tip: Each Instance node's copies of its prototype mesh (else small markers)

items.label: Scalp
items.tip: The scalp mesh in the viewport

items.label: GPU Preview
items.tip: Slider, seed and profile drags of Noise, Curl, Width, Clump, Length and Interpolate, and brush dabs, previewed by the GPU (Direct3D 11, OpenGL); the release commits on the CPU

items.label: Strand Color Mode
items.tip: What colors the strands: the look (lit), a color set of the scalp at the root, a per-strand channel over the range below (a ramp from blue to red), a random color per strand, the clump each strand belongs to, or how dense the strands are

items.label: Source
items.tip: The color set or the strand channel read (clumpId, melanin, length...)

items.label: Strand Color Min
items.tip: The attribute's value shown blue

items.label: Strand Color Max
items.tip: The attribute's value shown red

items.label: Map on Scalp
items.tip: A painted map drawn on the scalp: a vertex map's values, a guide layer blended between the guides, a texture at the scalp's vertices

items.label: Map Channel
items.tip: A color map shown in color, or one channel as gray

items.label: Display Overlays On Top
items.tip: Guides, their dots, parts and flow arrows over the strands, tubes and cards (not through the head and the other meshes); off, depth-tested like everything else

items.label: Guide Width
items.tip: The guides' width in pixels (selected guides one more)

items.label: Guide Points
items.tip: The guides' points as dots: off, roots and tips, or all

items.label: Guide Smoothing
items.tip: Guides draw as a smooth curve through their points: this many pieces per segment (1: straight segments)

items.label: Isolate Group
items.tip: One guide group at full color with its child groups, the others dimmed (empty: none; the Groom Tools' Isolate sets it)

items.label: Guide Color
items.tip: Each guide group's own color, or a painted guide layer from black to white

items.label: Display Lighting
items.tip: The strands lit by the lights (Kajiya-Kay lines)

tips.app: The line path's Kajiya-Kay shading (Lookdev off)

items.label: Display Hair Shading
items.tip: How the strands are shaded: Maya's own, or GroomLab's hair shading (the look as the render has it)

tips.app: The strands as shaded ribbons under the look's material and lights, as the render shades them (off: lines)

items.label: Display Self Shadowing
items.tip: How dark the strands get under the strands above them (GroomLab's hair shading)

items.label: Display Strand Variation
items.tip: Each strand's own brightness and hue spread (GroomLab's hair shading)

items.label: Display Shadows
items.tip: Shadows of the hair: off, cast on the scene, or cast and received

items.label: Display Width Coverage
items.tip: Strands a pixel wide, each point covering the share of the pixel its width covers: tapered tips fade, thin strands read light, dense hair builds up (off: opaque lines)

items.label: Display Coverage Density
items.tip: Width coverage at the render's density: a thinned preview's strands each cover what the strands they stand for would, so the preview reads as dense as the render

items.label: Display Clump Lod
items.tip: Level of detail: each clump draws as few of its strands as cover its pixels, each standing for the rest, and a clump thinner than a pixel as one line; chosen by the camera's distance. Off: every strand

items.label: Clump Lod Error
items.tip: The coverage error the level of detail may make: lower draws more strands

items.label: Use Material Color
items.tip: The strands in the hair shader's color (else Display Color)

items.label: Display Color
items.tip: The strands' color without a material color

items.label: Display Ribbons
items.tip: The strands at their true width: ribbons facing the camera as wide as the strands, at least a pixel, the thinner parts fading with their width (slower than lines close up)

items.label: Ribbon Width Scale
items.tip: Times the strands' widths in the viewport (ribbons, and lines with width coverage)

items.label: Sculpt Display
items.tip: The strands while a stroke is live: as they are, dimmed, or the guides alone

items.label: Sculpt Density
items.tip: The share of the strands evaluated while a stroke is live (all of them again when it ends)

items.label: Soft Select Radius
items.tip: Guides near the selected ones weigh in, falling off over this distance (0: off)

items.label: Display Cards
items.tip: The Cards nodes' cards instead of the strands (when the graph has a Cards node)

items.label: Display Card Textures
items.tip: The cards with their baked maps

items.label: Card Density
items.tip: The strand density the viewport's cards are built from (the bake and the export use every strand): lower only to rough cards in on a heavy groom

items.label: Render Mode
items.tip: How Arnold renders the groom: as curves Maya hands it, or from the groom file by the procedural

items.label: Groom File
items.tip: The groom file this groom is linked to (imported from, saved to)

sections.label: Render Overrides
sections.about: Render overrides: the render (Arnold, exports with render overrides) changes them, the viewport and the groom stay as groomed.

items.label: Render Density
items.tip: The share of the strands rendered, by the preview's thinning: the same look with fewer strands (1: every strand)

tips.app: The share of the strands rendered (V-Ray, RenderMan) and exported, by the preview's thinning: the same look with fewer strands (1: every strand)

items.label: Render Width Scale
items.tip: Times every strand's width in renders

items.label: Render Length Scale
items.tip: Each strand scaled about its root in renders, shape and all (a Transform node's scale): 0.5 renders it at half size

items.label: Lod Distance
items.tip: Strands far from the camera thinned (each kept with a probability falling from 1 at Lod Near to Lod Min Density at Lod Far, the same strands every frame), the survivors widened to keep the coverage

tips.app: Strands far from the camera thinned in a V-Ray frame (each kept with a probability falling from 1 at Near to Min Density at Far, the same strands every frame), the survivors widened to keep the coverage

items.label: Lod Near
items.tip: Full density up to this distance from the camera (scene units)

items.label: Lod Far
items.tip: Lod Min Density from this distance on (scene units)

items.label: Lod Min Density
items.tip: The share of the strands kept far away, 0-1

items.label: Lod Width Compensation
items.tip: The survivors widened by density^-compensation (1 keeps the coverage, 0 keeps their widths)

items.label: Camera Cull
items.tip: Strands wholly outside the camera's view dropped

tips.app: Strands wholly outside the camera's view dropped (a V-Ray frame; a turntable keeps them)

items.label: Cull Margin
items.tip: The view widened by this share on each side before culling (shadows and reflections close to frame)

items.label: Backface Cull
items.tip: Strands whose root faces away from the camera dropped (the back of the head)

tips.app: Strands whose root faces away from the camera dropped (the back of the head; a V-Ray frame, a turntable keeps them)

items.label: Backface Angle
items.tip: Degrees past side-on a root may face away and stay (silhouettes, long hair)
